hypothesis: For two- and three-row target verification, keeping independent Q8_K accumulators inside one Q4_K decode loop will reduce repeated nibble and scale extraction without changing each row's arithmetic order.

controls.control: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order ragged dispatch v1
controls.candidate: Same source and dispatch plus fused AVX2 Q4_K decode

observational_feasibility_result.status: observed before this whole-model MTP gate was frozen
observational_feasibility_result.benchmark: Real Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M prompt-only graphs, 14 samples per width
observational_feasibility_result.interpretation: These measurements motivated the full MTP run and are descriptive rather than a preregistered discovery test.

stop_rules: Reject on any cross-runtime exact-greedy token mismatch.
Reject if target-only accepted throughput regresses by more than two percent.
Reject if MTP3 accepted throughput improves by less than five percent.
Treat an unchanged target-versus-MTP parity pattern in both runtimes as upstream speculative behavior, not a candidate regression.
claim_boundary: A pass promotes this AVX2 Q4_K verification kernel on the four-core Milan development host only. It does not establish model quality, final-node scaling, or 100 accepted tokens per second.
